description:
**TYPE:** infographic

**TITLE:** none

**TEXT IN IMAGE:**
Employee Benefits
• Saves time
• Reduces spending on gas
• Decreases stress
• Improves work-life balance

Employer Benefits
• Reduces spending on real estate, utilities, overhead
• Increases employee productivity

Other Benefits
• Reduces greenhouse emissions
• Decreases dependence on oil imports
• Aligns with future trending (Bring Your Own Device, Software as a Service)

**DATA:**
The graphic lists three categories of telecommuting benefits arranged around a circular photo of a woman using a laptop outdoors:
* **Employee Benefits:** Saves time; Reduces spending on gas; Decreases stress; Improves work-life balance.
* **Employer Benefits:** Reduces spending on real estate, utilities, overhead; Increases employee productivity.
* **Other Benefits:** Reduces greenhouse emissions; Decreases dependence on oil imports; Aligns with future trending (Bring Your Own Device, Software as a Service).

**KEY FACTS:**
* Lists four specific benefits for employees, including time and gas savings, reduced stress, and better work-life balance.
* Highlights two major benefits for employers: reduced overhead costs (real estate, utilities) and increased productivity.
* Outlines broader societal and technological ("Other") benefits such as reduced emissions, lower oil dependence, and alignment with BYOD and SaaS trends.
